# Model families: what the registers say

<!-- Generated by tools/family_matrix.py from docs/capabilities.json and docs/claims.json. Do not edit by hand: change a register, then run `python tools/family_matrix.py`. CI runs it with --check. -->

One view per model family (transformers `model_type`) of what the project's two registers record. A cell changes when a register changes, never by hand. The dated documents ([support matrix](support_matrix.md), [architecture support](ARCHITECTURE_SUPPORT.md)) keep their evidence; this page indexes the registers and supersedes neither.
